scope: Source/build/headless verification only. No native GUI, GPU hardware or engineering certification.
fingerprint_scope: Application Rust/manifests/PTX/Python/license notices/locks and clean SDK revision; not compiler/OS tracing or a hash of every fixture/document.

commands.command: cargo build --offline --locked -p ai_revit_desktop --bin ai_revit_desktop -p ai_revit_core --example geo_foundation_cli -j1

synthetic_cli_lifecycle.scope: Explicit synthetic create, query, structural/foundation calculation, Save/Open, edit/stale, Undo/Redo and rejection controls; separate local publication verifier.
synthetic_cli_lifecycle.archive_distribution: Process receipts and generated calculation archives excluded from source Git tree.

limits.cuda_test: One hardware test ignored without explicit supported NVIDIA adapter opt-in.
